name: Jungle Remedy
summary: At the Rebel Camp, Jungle Remedy can help keep the wounded fighting fit against Kurzen’s forces. Sergeant Yohwa needs remedies from the Kurzen Compound to treat the camp’s fighters.

sections.title: A Camp’s Need
sections.body: Kurzen’s Medicine Men use Jungle Remedies to heal their fighters in the compound. Sergeant Yohwa needs them at the Rebel Camp, where they can help keep his own people alive and ready to fight.

faq.answer: Sergeant Yohwa needs Jungle Remedies to treat the Rebel Camp’s fighters and keep them in fighting shape against Kurzen.
Kurzen Medicine Men, Witch Doctors, and Headshrinkers carry Jungle Remedies. Jungle Fighters have them occasionally.

faq.q: Why does Sergeant Yohwa need them?
faq.answer: The Kurzen forces use the remedies to heal their own fighters, and Sergeant Yohwa needs them to care for the wounded at the Rebel Camp.

faq.q: Where can I find Jungle Remedies?
faq.answer: Search the Kurzen Compound in Stranglethorn Vale; Kurzen’s healers and other fighters carry the remedies.
